scene: You ride along inside the tow truck's rumbling, cluttered cabin.
beats: Static pops into jaunty synth jazz as the truck rolls to a stop. The door swings wide to a dazzling, buzzing pink glow.
Inside rests a glowing miniature glass pretzel. You slip it into your jacket just as the truck stops and the door opens into the humming neon workshop.
The pug snorts softly and rests its chin on your knee. The truck purrs to a halt, and the door pops open to a kaleidoscope of flickering signs.
picture: Flat side-view across the tow truck's wide cabin interior. On the far left sits a bulky glowing radio. The driver grips the wheel on the left. At centre, the player sits beside a taped glovebox. On the right, a snoring pug curls up on the passenger bench. Through the windshield, Gear Bridge recedes.
shown: a bulky dashboard radio with glowing dials on the left
a taped-shut metal glovebox below the dash at centre
a wrinkled pug snoring softly on the seat on the right

after.label: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital
Stay on
after.beat: The driver waves as you rumble past the glowing hospital, sharing peppermints until the route ends. You transfer to a window-cleaner gondola that hoists you straight up into Rainmaker Rooftops.
